title: Lining installation.
officialText:
Linings shall be interrupted at the area of operation of a fire damper and at a minimum of 6 inches (152
mm) upstream of and 6 inches (152 mm) downstream of electric-resistance and fuel-burning heaters in a duct system. Metal nosings
or sleeves shall be installed over exposed duct liner edges that face opposite the direction of airflow.
